Trig Identity Proof, Class 10 board exam: ye proof dekh ke dar lagta hai? Prove (1 + tan A)² + (1 - tan A)² = 2 sec²A step by step, from the LHS to the RHS.

• Start from the LHS and expand both squares: 1 + 2 tan A + tan²A and 1 - 2 tan A + tan²A
• Add them: +2 tan A and -2 tan A cancel, so LHS = 2 + 2 tan²A
• Take 2 common: LHS = 2(1 + tan²A)
• Use 1 + tan²A = sec²A: LHS = 2 sec²A = RHS, hence proved
